note: Voice lines for the dialogue, rendered by tools/render-voices.mjs (run by the Render voices workflow). Words follow the hand lettering; bracketed directions are audio tags and are not spoken. A line renders only when its voice is set; changing a line's text, voice or settings renders it again. The Render voices workflow runs whenever this file changes on main or the working branch. Spoken text may differ from the lettering for pronunciation: "Canes" is said "caynis" (Paul), so it is spelt "Caynis"; the hyphens make "Spomenik-Operative-Bob" one name, QNTM CTRL is said "quantum control", and Cryptoflage rhymes with camouflage, so it is spelt "Crypto-flahzh". "Engage..." ends on a full stop, like all of Smokehouse's lines now. All lines use Eleven v4 (eleven_v4, Paul, 24 October), which takes only stability and similarity_boost as settings (style and speaker boost are not supported), so pacing and delivery come from the audio tags and punctuation. A line's "take" number asks for a fresh render of the same words: raise it to hear another take. Smokehouse is rL5thyifUCj65q3mamdf (Paul, 25 October, replacing v0eRobr4pSbFT9FKocdw, which replaced t1yzxMpe9zK42bXmI1T2), read calm and insistent (Paul): a [calm, insistent] tag, full stops rather than exclamation marks, stability 0.5 for all her lines. The narrator is uVKHymY7OYMd6OailpG5 (Paul, 25 October). Smokehouse is a woman (Paul, 25 October), with no accent (the Russian accent and its spellings are gone); similarity is 0.85 so more of the voice's own character comes through. Smokehouse's radio drive is 1.8 (was 3.2) so the old shouting no longer rasped, and her reverb send is 0.22 into a wide 5 s tail (Paul).

bob.note: Bob is the alien voice Paul chose (deep-wet-1, ElevenLabs Voice Design, 24 October), heard dry. His lines are cut from that take by tools/cut_bob_voice.py (each has a source), so render-voices.mjs leaves them alone; the id here is his old human voice until the designed one is saved (voices/alien-tests/results.json, adopted).
